blurb: A template with no fields type is `Html` as it stands, so a `\(name)` in it has nothing to fill it. Declare the fields record, or write the text itself as `\(name)`. Any other backslash and parenthesis, such as MathJax's `\(x^2\)`, is already text.
summary: A template declared without a fields type has a placeholder (#3927).
